engines.name: Wall
engines.description: Axis walls with layered types, explicit topology (joins, tees, miters), hosted openings, vertical intent and room bounding.

engines.name: Point component
engines.description: Family -> ComponentType -> Component placed at a storey-relative point (furniture, equipment, fixtures, ...).

engines.name: Hosted component
engines.description: Components filling a host void (doors, windows): they follow the opening in their host wall.

engines.name: Profile member
engines.description: Linear members with a profile type swept along an axis (beams) or a vertical (columns), with vertical intent.

engines.name: Boundary element
engines.description: Polygon-bounded elements (outline + holes) extruded by a layered type from a horizontal reference level (floors, ceilings, flat roofs) or from a sloped plane (single-plane roofs). The category decides the thickness direction.

engines.name: Spatial element
engines.description: Rooms / spaces: a persisted location point; boundary, area and volume derived from explicitly joined room-bounding walls.

engines.name: Stair
engines.description: Straight-run stairs: a walking line, width and riser count; the total rise follows the storeys (vertical intent). Treads and risers are derived.

engines.name: Path element
engines.description: Elements whose geometry follows a semantic polyline (railings): open or closed path, base offset, height; posts and rails are derived from the path and the type.

engines.name: MEP fitting
engines.description: Fitting products of MEP networks (elbow, tee, cross, reducer, transition, coupling): a point placement with yaw / pitch / roll in a system; connectors and swept / revolved geometry are derived from the type's parameters. Connectivity stays explicit (MepJunction).

engines.name: Reinforcement
engines.description: Bar sets, meshes, tendons and tendon conduits bound to an explicit host (column, beam, wall, slab, footing, foundation slab): a bar path + count / spacing / direction per layer; every bar, its length and its volume are derived. The bars move with their host.

engines.name: Assembly
engines.description: Explicit aggregation of existing elements (IfcElementAssembly): trusses, frames, prefabricated and precast units, facade modules. Children keep their identity and lifecycle; one parent per child; acyclic; one storey. No geometry of its own.

engines.name: Ramp flight
engines.description: A straight sloped walking surface: walking line, width, rise, base elevation; slope limit and thickness from the RampType. Flights and landings are joined into a ramp by an assembly.

engines.name: Curtain wall
engines.description: A curtain-wall assembly on a straight axis: base, height, grid; the type carries the maximum cell size, mullion / transom sections and panel thickness. Grid, mullions, transoms and panels are derived with stable ids; IFC decomposes the curtain wall into plates and members.

engines.name: Pitched roof
engines.description: Gable and hip roofs on a rectangular footprint: form, pitch, ridge side, overhang, eave elevation; a layered roof type gives the thickness. Planes, ridge, hips and eaves are derived with stable plane ids; IFC aggregates IfcSlab ROOF planes into an IfcRoof. No valleys, openings or general footprints.

engines.name: Opening (internal)
engines.description: Internal host-cut primitive: a void in a wall that a hosted component may fill. Not an authorable BIM engine.

engines.name: MEP network
engines.description: Route elements of connected MEP networks (pipes, ducts, cable trays, conduits): a storey-aware 3D polyline in a system, with stable endpoint connectors. Connectivity is explicit (MepJunction resources): touching is never connected. No engineering analysis.

engines.name: Proxy (reserved)
engines.description: Reserved for imported proxies. Not implemented.
